study.question: Do global separated field means retain the gain of four ordered field groups at lower measured cost, once redundant event embedding work is controlled?
study.hypothesis: Observed r0008 field direction gains are +0.000554707 AUC in semantic groups and +0.000492331 in rank groups, whereas rank vs semantic direction differs only +0.000081958. Rank diagnostics show sequence-reversal logit max 0.9804504 and context-reversal max 0.4654937 on 512 impressions, versus approximately 1e-6 for semantic groups; these are structural sensitivities, not predictive ablations. Rank training cost 731.36s vs r0007 independent/match 596.98s (+22.5%) with only +0.000122588 AUC; source re-embeds events independently in three branches. Hypothesis: global per-field directions plus inherited semantic means/counts/histograms/moments can preserve validation AUC within 0.0002 while removing positional field-group readout and 18432 dense weights; shared embeddings reduce redundant computation. This is unverified local compression, not a novelty claim.

nearest_work.difference: DIN uses target-aware weighted pooling; this proposal retains inherited hard target-match aggregate branches but compresses only the appended separated-field contrasts into a global linear mean. It adds no learned attention and makes no DIN reproduction/priority claim.
Only the field-availability warning is verified: category, brand, behavior type and no item histories. Full DMR paper unavailable; no detailed mechanism comparison or reproduction claim.

Closest implementation. Keep learned tables, mixed semantic means, counts, histogram, independent moments and MLP. Replace only the appended four-group contrast readout with one global block; independently control shared execution, width and direction.

inherited_components: All supplied ancestor embeddings and shallow MLP; dormant attention allocation kept for initialization matching
g1-r0002 log-count statistics; g1-r0005 semantic mean groups; g1-r0006 observed semantic action-age histograms
g1-r0008 fixed Hadamard field decomposition and norm-preserving direction replacement
study.proposed_difference: Use a single global masked mean for each field and its three Hadamard contrasts, instead of four rank-conditioned field contrast blocks. The mixed target-aware parent branches remain. An isometric four-copy expansion matches allocated downstream width; compact removes redundancy. Shared event embeddings are an independently checked execution change. No extra data, labels, supervision, optimizer, history or scorer changes. Shared execution also omits the unused global mixed mean and unselected observed cross-moment computation from the inherited production forward; execution savings cannot be assigned to embedding reuse alone. Diagnostic reference methods remain unchanged.
predictions: rank_shared same-checkpoint logits and features should agree with inherited legacy forward up to floating-point tolerance (diagnostic maximum logit difference <=1e-4); allocated parameters must equal 17177891. Exact single-forward equivalence does not guarantee identical accumulated embedding gradients or training trajectories; host backward validation is required.
global_wide vs rank_shared AUC loss should not exceed the prospective 0.0002 practical margin; compact should also retain quality while reducing dense parameters by exactly 18432.
global_compact should exceed global_norm AUC if field directions contribute beyond their norm; a null contrast limits that interpretation.
global variants should be invariant to sequence reversal and within-semantic-group action/age bundle reversal, up to roundoff; rank_shared may remain sensitive.
Shared reference should reduce measured train/wall/peak memory versus archived incumbent; compact should reduce first-layer cost versus global_wide. These are predictions, not measured savings.
falsifiers: Finite-forward, shape, empty-history, padding or same-checkpoint reference mismatch invalidates execution rather than refuting the scientific hypothesis.
Global-wide AUC loss >0.0002 against rank_shared contradicts proposed sufficiency at seed 42; do not select it solely for parameter savings.
Global compact not better than compact norm control undermines directional attribution in this global architecture.
No measured cost reduction invalidates an efficiency claim even if static operation/parameter counts shrink.
Single-seed near ties do not establish equivalence or significance.
alternative_explanations: r0008 gains are seed noise or accumulated validation-selection bias after many rounds.
Small conditional groups or supplied ordering contain useful recency/field detail discarded globally.
Prior count-vs-rate gains and summary-only failures show activity and learned content are complementary; global direction may add nothing beyond existing branches.

r0000 rare-action grouping failed; r0001 separate fields alone failed; r0002 observed/independent count tie weakens joint-count necessity; r0006 pairing evidence modest; r0007 observed moments did not consistently beat independent. No single pooled mechanism explains all trajectories.
Runtime load and initialization/gradient differences can mimic cost/quality gains.
